overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running sessions and optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence logic for the endgame phase. This batch ensures memory stability and logical consistency for 5,500+ tick simulations.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array for fixed-size buffers. Implement a bitwise packing scheme for tick states. No dynamic allocations. Use constexpr for table generation. Ensure strict little-endian serialization.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compress 5,500 ticks into <1KB. 2. Decompression yields identical state. 3. Zero heap allocations during compression cycle.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times and stable memory usage for long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence for Endgame
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement early-exit criteria for variance < 1e-6. Use SIMD-friendly struct layout for particle states. Cache intermediate sums in registers.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Convergence achieved in <100 iterations for stable states. 2. No deadlocks in 16,500 step logs. 3. 100% survival rate maintained.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother physics interactions in dense endgame scenarios.
